title: Raw localization of one exact linear integral adjunction
statement: Fix a prime $l$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_l$, a finite coefficient field stage $E$, and schemes $X,Y$ in the published coefficient universes. Let $A=(F,G,F\dashv G)$ be an exact integral Operation [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data], and assume both functors are $\mathcal O_E$-linear [def-weil-linear-category]. Suppose the integral constructible and finite-Tor integral predicates agree on each endpoint. The functor integralRepresentative only changes the proof of membership; fullIntegralFunctor is its composite with the given functor and the full inclusion on the target. Define rawRationalFunctor on a represented object by the same integral image, and on tensor Homs by the base change of fullIntegralFunctor.mapLinearMap, as in [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. There exist an adjunction and exact additive shift structures on these two fixed raw functors, and a counit-normalized comparison with the supplied integral adjunction. Its q and b are the identity on every integral representative. The two endpoint localization shifts are exactly integralRationalizationShift, obtained from the inherited full-subcategory inclusion shift followed by the canonical rationalization shift. There is no morphism of schemes, compactification, compact-support identification, or change of coefficient field in this assertion.

proof.text: Obtain an exact shift-compatible adjunction on the fixed raw tensor functors from exists_raw_localized_adjunction_core. Its construction transports the full integral adjunction and applies the proved localization and exactness helpers.

Apply exists_raw_localized_identity_comparison to the obtained RawLocalizedAdjunction and package the two witnesses. This step remains sorry, and its arbitrary-R comparison statement is marked STATEMENT-DISPUTED in Lean because the structure has no normalization hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_integral_adjunction_raw_localization
    (A : Operation.{u, v} l Ω X Y (.integral E))
    [A.F.Additive] [A.G.Additive]
    [A.F.Linear (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E.carrier)]
    [A.G.Linear (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E.carrier)]
    (hX : sfIntegralConstructible l E.carrier X = finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier X)
    (hY : sfIntegralConstructible l E.carrier Y = finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier Y) :
    ∃ (R : RawLocalizedAdjunction l Ω E X Y A hX hY)
      (q : CounitFieldComparison.{u, v} l Ω A (R.operation l Ω E)
        (rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E X) (rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E Y)),
      (∀ K, HEq (q.q.hom.app K)
        (𝟙 ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E Y).obj (A.F.obj K)))) ∧
      (∀ M, HEq (q.b.hom.app M)
        (𝟙 ((rationalization.{u, v} l Ω E X).obj (A.G.obj M)))) ∧
      q.shiftX = integralRationalizationShift l Ω E X ∧
      q.shiftY = integralRationalizationShift l Ω E Y
